card.name: Countable nouns after quantity phrases
card.fires_on: The countable noun right after a number or quantity phrase such as "first few", "four or more", "more than three" or "up to 6". Typical nouns are courses, times, cycles, drugs, stools and migraines.

modes.label: Counted units of treatment
modes.description: Courses, cycles or drugs counted after a quantity phrase.
modes.example: Patients with hairy cell leukemia may experience myelosuppression primarily during the first few<< courses>> of treatment.

modes.label: Counted events per period
modes.description: Times, stools or migraines counted per day or month.
modes.example: (i.e., up to 6<< stools>> per day over baseline)
